استبيت (form VIII)
# اِسْتَبَيْتُ (istabaytu) /is.ta.baj.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِسْتَبَى (istabā)
# اِسْتَبَيْتَ (istabayta) /is.ta.baj.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَبَى (istabā)
# اِسْتَبَيْتِ (istabayti) /is.ta.baj.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَبَى (istabā)
# اُسْتُبِيتُ (ustubītu) /us.tu.biː.tu/: first-person singular
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
